nodes.label: Captio App - Notas de Caso Screen (ES)
nodes.description: Screenshot of the Captio legal app dashboard showing the 'Notas de caso' (Case Notes) section in Spanish. The UI displays a left sidebar with navigation items: Nuevo Cliente, Clientes, Notas de caso (active/highlighted), and Archivos. A language toggle (ES/EN) is shown at the bottom of the sidebar. The main content area shows a search bar ('Buscar caso por número o nombre...') and two case cards: '#4 · Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' (category: Negocios/contrato) and '#1 · Toledo Realtors'. The logged-in user is 'toledolaw' shown in the top-right with an online status indicator. The app tagline reads 'intake · brief · equipo'. A help button is visible at the bottom-right corner.
nodes.ui_purpose: Case notes listing view allowing users to select a case to view or create associated notes
